VANG INST TR 2055.note: Vanguard Institutional Target Retirement 2055 Fund. Discontinued 2022-02 when Vanguard moved institutional clients to the Target Retirement CIT.

VANG INTL GROWTH ADM.note: Vanguard International Growth Fund Admiral Shares

VANG TR II 2055.note: Target Retirement 2055 Trust II CIT. No public ticker. Uses VFFVX (retail Target 2055) return stream; acquired fund fees 0.075% vs VFFVX's 0.08% — basically identical. anchor_date / anchor_price are auto-populated on the first run from the user's earliest txn price, then frozen.

VANG US GROWTH ADM.note: Vanguard U.S. Growth Fund Admiral Shares

Vanguard Employee Benefit Index Fund.note: Vanguard 401K CIT tracking the S&P 500. Holds VFIAX shares internally (lower expense ratio: 0.006% vs VFIAX's 0.04%). Different NAV, identical return stream to VFIAX over any meaningful period. anchor_date / anchor_price are auto-populated on the first run from the user's earliest txn price, then frozen.

_comment_1: Hand-editable proxy map for symbols yfinance can't resolve (multi-word display names, ticker-format aliases, private collective investment trusts). Consulted by prices.get_price BEFORE the usual fetch path.
_comment_2: method='direct'  -> use the proxy's adjusted close as-is (ticker alias or class-equivalent fund that trades at the same NAV).
_comment_3: method='scaled'  -> anchor to the first-observed txn price for this symbol, then use the proxy's RETURN stream to drive valuations. Good for CITs that track a public fund but have different NAVs/expense ratios.
_comment_4: Scaled entries auto-populate anchor_date + anchor_price on the first pipeline run if missing. Hand-edit to override.
